item.title: Nest boxes continue to boost Black Cockatoo numbers in fire-affected hills
item.description: More than a decade after the 2014 Perth Hills bushfires devastated Parkerville, Stoneville and Mount Helena, endangered black cockatoos are still finding safe places to raise their young.
